'''''KJB-87''''' was a cargo [[Transport/Legends|transport]] used to transfer cargo from orbital warehouses to the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during its construction over [[Despayre]]. It was also used by [[Celot Ratua Dil]] during his escape from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to transport him from ''[[Machine Tool Storage Unit Alpha-Four]]'' to the Death Star itself.
